title: AB202 (2019 Regular): Authorizes the possession of a handgun in a motor vehicle that is on the property of a community college under certain circumstances. (BDR 15-652)

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Nevada) (gun-policy Stage 5, Nevada); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Nevada text (As introduced, official copy, https://archive.leg.state.nv.us/Session/80th2019/Bills/AB/AB202.pdf; sha256 309c1794a8fb21b7e5059338d17970060fea2e1b27c362953868e3a1cbe1d979)
provenance.note: As-filed (introduced) text, no passage vote recorded. NRS 202.265 changes in this version also strike old wording (a 'vehicle' definition and the word 'vehicle' in subsection 1, and renumbering letters); those struck words are not quoted.

operative_text:
Section 1 (NRS 202.265): (b) A handgun on the property of a community college within the Nevada System of Higher Education by a person, if the handgun remains out of common observation and is stored in a locked container which is affixed securely to the frame of a motor vehicle, other than a school bus.
Section 2 (NRS 202.3673): (2) Possesses a handgun in accordance with the provisions of paragraph (b) of subsection 3 of NRS 202.265.
